one_liner: Consensus offers a self-serve REST API for scholarly paper search with a free tier (30 calls/month), API keys, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: API key via x-api-key header, generated self-serve in dashboard. OAuth 2.0 auth code + PKCE (scope search) with dynamic client registration issuing public clients; confidential clients provisioned on request. OAuth guide also describes Access Credentials in the web app for the V2 platform API. API key kept primary since the main REST API documents it and OAuth scope is narrow.
access_notes: Every plan, including Free (30 calls/month, 20 papers per request, no pagination), includes API access; keys created in the API & MCP Dashboard.
blocker_notes: Free tier is limited (30 calls/month, 1 req/s) but sufficient to build and test.

evidence.quote: Every request must include your API key in the `x-api-key` header:
Authorization-code flow only. There is no client-credentials grant, so OAuth always involves a per-user consent step; each user signs in to their own Consensus account.
The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan.
Every plan includes API access, and the Free plan includes 30 calls a month.
search 400+ million scholarly articles, including 350 million peer-reviewed research papers, over a single REST endpoint.
The official Consensus MCP server gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Perplexity and any other MCP client semantic search
